rationale: The agent located the user and orders via find_user_id_by_email/get_user_details and fetched order details. However, the agent executed return_delivered_order_items on both orders without clear prior user confirmation, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing action. Moreover, per the transfer_to_human_agents summary, the returns were processed to the wrong refund methods relative to the user’s request (the user wanted each order refunded to the opposite order’s payment method). This means the agent did not complete the user’s request as specified and performed writes without ensuring alignment. While the agent eventually handed off to a human, it did so after making incorrect changes. Therefore, it fails the pass criteria.
